sources.note: Main RPMS page. Describes RPMS as a decentralized integrated solution with over 50 software applications for clinical and administrative information management. Lists application categories (clinical, administrative, infrastructure).
ONC certification overview page. Confirms RPMS EHR certified 2025-11-24 (BCERv9.0). Lists certified criteria and references decision support intervention risk management and attestation documents.
IHS EHR main page with overview of the EHR GUI layer built on VueCentric framework.
Technical overview of EHR architecture: VueCentric framework, RPC Broker client-server communication, component-based GUI with COM/ActiveX objects, no dedicated EHR server required.

Comprehensive list of clinical RPMS applications including PCC, Pharmacy, Lab, Immunizations, Behavioral Health, Dental, Emergency Room, Women's Health, Diabetes Management, HIV, Chronic Disease Management, and many more.

Administrative applications list including Third Party Billing, Accounts Receivable, Patient Registration, PIMS (ADT/Scheduling), Practice Management, Pharmacy Point of Sale, and administrative resource management.
Infrastructure applications including FileMan, Kernel, HL7, MailMan, RPC Broker, BMXNet, Data Warehouse Export, code mapping, and IRIS/Cache database classes.
EHI Export schema documentation page. Contains IHS_EHI_Schema_Definition.pdf and versioned schema text files (BREH_OIT) for 2023, 2024, and 2025.

Detailed history of RPMS from origins in 1960s IHS computing through 2010s. Covers PCC development, key contributors, hardware evolution, relationship to VistA, and the V-file architecture. Essential source for understanding RPMS's clinical data model.
Technical analysis of RPMS-VistA convergence feasibility. Details package-by-package code divergence (e.g., Lab: 819/1132 routines modified). Explains PCC vs PCE as the most significant barrier.
Coverage of IHS's decision to replace RPMS with Oracle Cerner via GDIT contract. Details data migration strategy: only 24 months of clinical data migrates; rest archived in Four Directions Warehouse.
Report on Regenstrief Institute assessment. User satisfaction data: 60.3% say RPMS needs significant improvements or complete overhaul, 93% agree it's time to replace.
Coverage of IHS proceeding with EHR modernization. Details GDIT selection, $2.5 billion potential contract value, Oracle Cerner technology choice.
IHS CIO Mitchell Thornbrugh interview. Details lifecycle cost estimates ($4.5-6.2 billion), funding requests, pilot site plans, data migration concerns.
Official IHS announcement of GDIT selection for enterprise EHR modernization.
Details IHS's health information exchange modernization: InterSystems data warehouse, HL7 C-CDA pipeline, HL7 ADT messaging, FHIR API pilot testing.
Medsphere Systems (VueCentric framework owner) page about RPMS enhancements and their CareVue EHR alternative for tribal sites.
HHS strategic options document for IHS health IT modernization. Assessment that RPMS will be completely unsupportable in 10 years under current configuration.
